title: Al-Halim: The Divine Name for the Punishment That Has Not Come Yet
excerpt: Al-Halim is translated "the Forbearing." Al-Jalalayn defines it far more sharply: by delaying the punishment away from the one who deserves it. Fifteen occurrences, eleven of them naming God.
seo_title: Al-Halim: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Halim occurs 15 times in the Quran, 11 naming God. Al-Jalalayn glosses it as the deferral of a deserved punishment. What the name means, verse by verse.
